summary.business_type: Browser game / fan entertainment (publisher-like), French market
top_findings: JJK meta descriptions on 20 non-JJK game pages; JJK body copy on tower and draft pages
54/54 game pages thin (38-117 words SSR), 36 without H1, cross-universe similarity 0.67-0.90
Soft-200: /favicon.ico and /*.png render the JJK landing with 200; no favicon
Fragmented entity: 7 WebSite + 7 Organization, manifest says JJK Arcade, JJK slugs on all universes
Mobile: cookie banner covers ~50% of viewport over CTAs; mobile LCP 4.2-6.5s, builder CLS 0.397
quick_wins: Template 4 hard-coded JJK seoDescription strings from universe config
notFound() on unknown [universe] slug + add app/favicon.ico
Keep one logo preload; resize logos to display size

findings.title: Soft-200 for root static-extension paths
findings.description: /favicon.ico and /nothing.png return 200 HTML (JJK landing, index,follow, canonical /jjk); [universe] slug not validated.
findings.recommendation: notFound() for unknown slugs in app/[universe]/layout.tsx; add app/favicon.ico.

findings.title: llms.txt and .well-known redirected into /jjk then 404
findings.description: Middleware 307s unprefixed paths to the cookie universe.
findings.recommendation: Add to UNIVERSE_FREE_PREFIXES and matcher exclusions; publish llms.txt.

findings.title: HTML never cached; origin iad1 for French audience
findings.description: Cache-Control private no-store, X-Vercel-Cache MISS, force-dynamic pages.
findings.recommendation: regions cdg1; static/ISR for hub, landings and /games.

findings.title: /casino indexable thin page
findings.description: 54 words, title Casino, index,follow.
findings.recommendation: noindex and add virtual-currency notice.

findings.title: /login robots-blocked with noindex and canonical /jjk
findings.description: Google cannot read the noindex.
findings.recommendation: Remove from robots disallow and drop canonical override.

findings.title: Hosted on vercel.app subdomain
findings.description: No brand-owned domain; JJK-specific hostname for a multi-anime platform.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to custom domain with 308s, bundled with slug renames.

findings.title: JJK body copy on other universes
findings.description: Tower shows The Culling Tower, draft says Draft 1 sorcier on CSM/AOT/KNY/TG/Bleach.
findings.recommendation: Use universe labels in TowerGame, TowerLeaderboard, TowerRules, ShareRun, og/tower, JujutsuDraftGame.

findings.title: Thin game pages
findings.description: 38-117 SSR words, rules only in client modals.
findings.recommendation: 250-450 word SSR Comment jouer block per game with universe-specific data.

findings.title: Doorway-like cross-universe duplication
findings.description: Similarity vs JJK: tower 0.90, guesswho 0.87, battle 0.79, codenames 0.78, dle 0.67.
findings.recommendation: Differentiate with roster, attributes, signature characters.

findings.title: No trust pages
findings.description: No About, Mentions legales, privacy; Contact is a modal.
findings.recommendation: Create crawlable pages and link in footer.

findings.title: False Sans compte claims
findings.description: Multiplayer games require login.
findings.recommendation: Correct copy or allow guest play.

findings.title: Wrong-anime meta descriptions
findings.description: jjkdle/battle/guesswho/codenames page.tsx pass JJK seoDescription to all universes (20 pages).
findings.recommendation: Template from universe config.

findings.title: Duplicate descriptions
findings.description: ranking x6, higher-lower x4, draft TG=Bleach, /login=/jjk.
findings.recommendation: Per-universe descriptions.

findings.title: 36 game pages without H1
findings.description: builder, ranking, draft, dle, higher-lower, tower.
findings.recommendation: Server-rendered H1 with anime name and game type.

findings.title: JJK slugs on all universes
findings.description: /csm/games/jjkdle, /bleach/games/jujutsu-draft.
findings.recommendation: Rename with 308 redirects, bundled with domain migration.

findings.title: Long descriptions and missing og:image
findings.description: 50/69 descriptions >160 chars; 13 pages no og:image.
findings.recommendation: Front-load keywords; add images to openGraph.

findings.title: Duplicate WebSite/Organization on landings
findings.description: SiteJsonLd in page.tsx and UniverseChrome.
findings.recommendation: Remove the page.tsx instance.

findings.title: 7 WebSite and 7 Organization entities
findings.description: Per-universe WebSite/Org, no sameAs, JJK logo as platform logo.
findings.recommendation: Single Org+WebSite at /, universes as CollectionPage isPartOf.

findings.title: No breadcrumbs on game pages
findings.description: Only /games has BreadcrumbList.
findings.recommendation: Add BreadcrumbList; real genres; playMode.

findings.title: Mobile LCP 4.2-6.5 s
findings.description: 6 logo preloads ~830 KB on /, opacity-0 entrance animation, 144 KB header logo without dimensions.
findings.recommendation: One preload with fetchpriority high, resize logos, remove LCP animation.

findings.title: Builder CLS 0.397
findings.description: Grid container shifts; LCP image loaded late from API.
findings.recommendation: Reserve grid space; prioritise first character image.

findings.title: No HTML caching / bfcache fail
findings.description: private no-store on all pages.
findings.recommendation: ISR + cdg1 region.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: All AI and search crawlers get 200 with full SSR text
Accessible controls on / and dle page

findings.title: Low citability
findings.description: No passage answers how-to-play, reset time, roster size; wordle absent.
findings.recommendation: Answer-first how-to blocks per game.

findings.title: Split brand entity
findings.description: Anime Arcade vs JJK Arcade, no sameAs.
findings.recommendation: Unify under Anime Arcade.

findings.title: llms.txt broken
findings.description: 307 to /jjk/llms.txt then 404.
findings.recommendation: Serve at root.

findings.title: Search input lacks accessible name
findings.description: Placeholder only on dle character search.
findings.recommendation: aria-label + combobox role.

findings.title: Oversized logos and OG images
findings.description: Logos 112-162 KB WebP; OG PNG 0.7-1.3 MB.
findings.recommendation: Display-size logos ~20-40 KB; OG 1200x630 <=200 KB.

findings.title: Unused heavy files in public/
findings.description: 6.5 MB MP4s, 0.7-2.9 MB PNG originals.
findings.recommendation: Delete or move out of public/.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Remove JJK text from non-JJK universes (meta + body)

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Comment jouer content block per game
Fix mobile LCP and builder CLS
Root files, casino noindex, robots fixes, search a11y, CSP scope

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: About / Mentions legales / privacy / contact pages
French-first titles, /dle hub, slug renames + custom domain with 308s
OG image compression, lastmod from DB
